tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ :bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las: rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bkol byang bzhugs so: 12345:

spros med don gyi rnal 'byor pas: rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying po ni: dben par bsam gtan snod rung ba'i: yan lag thams cad tshogs par bya: de nas rtse gcig ting 'dzin gyis: lha sngags ye shes don la 'jug: na mo: bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus kun: skyabs kyi mchog gyur rnams la skyabs su mchi: smon dang 'jug pa'i byang chub sems bskyed nas: sku gsum bla ma'i go 'phang bsgrub par bgyi: hūm̐: stong nyid dbyings las ye shes kun tu snang : rgyu yi ting 'dzin hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: snang srid thams cad padma drwa ba'i zhing : ngo mtshar bkod pa bsam yas dkyil 'khor dbus: rin chen seng khri padma nyi zla'i steng : hrīḥyig yongs gyur bdag nyid skad cig gis: ma hā gu ru o rgyan thod phreng rtsal: snang srid zil gnon dkar dmar zhi khro'i nyams: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga mkha' la 'phyar: g.yon pas mnyam bzhag bde skyong tshe bum bsnams: gsang yum sbas tshul kha ṭwām̐ g.yon nas 'khril: pad zhwa gsang phod chos gos za ber gsol: zhabs gnyis rol stabs 'ja' zer klong na 'gying : spyi bor longs sku spyan ras gzigs dbang dang : rigs kyi bdag po tshe dpag med mgon bzhugs: steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnam 'phrul bcu gnyis dang : rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtsho sprin ltar gtibs: dam ye dbyer med gdod nas lhun grub pa'i: rigs bdag thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: srid zhi'i tshe bcud kun 'dus rang la thim: 'phags mchog 'gro 'dul thugs rje'i cho 'phrul gyis: rigs drug 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas sbyangs: rang nyid rigs 'dus bla ma'i thugs ka ru: gser gyi rdo rje'i lte bar hrīḥyig mthar: sngags kyi phreng bas bskor las 'od zer 'phros: 'phags pa mchod cing sems can don kun byas: phyi snod dag pa rab 'byams 'og min zhing : nang bcud snang srid gzhir bzhengs phyag rgya'i lha:

sgrar grags sngags la dran rtog 'od gsal dbyings: thun mong las bzhi'i phrin las lhun gyis grub: mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen rdo rje'i ngang : 'chi med sku gsum go 'phang thob par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: 'bru gsum sku gsum dbyer med la: badzra gu ru rigs kyi gtso: padma dkyil 'khor 'khor lor snang : siddhi hūm̐ zhes dngos grub bskul: bsnyen sgrub las gsum chig dril gyi: rdo rje'i sngags 'dis las kun byed: thun mthar rigs 'dus bla ma la: gsol ba gdab cing thugs yid bsre: dge tshogs bsngo smon rgya yis gdab: gong gi skyabs sems dang bsngo smon shis brjod 'di phrin las snying po'i rnal 'byor nas kha bskang ba'o/ mchan/ hoḥ rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgrubs pa'i mthus: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can ma lus kun: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang : 'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings su grol bar shog: rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs: yi dam mkha' 'gro lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs: chos skyong srung mas bar chad kun bsal nas: mchog thun dngos grub 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: dus kun rtsa ba'i bla ma dang : bdag nyid chen po padma la: dbyer med gsol 'debs mos gus kyis: bar chad kun sel dngos grub thob: sa ma ya: rgya rgya: sprul pa'i gter chen mchog gyur gling pa'i zab gter yang dag pa'o// PAGE PAGE 2
